name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
description: The medicine ball chest pass is a plyometric upper body exercise in which a medicine ball is explosively thrown forward from the chest against a wall or to a partner, then caught and immediately repeated. It trains the explosive pushing power of the pectoral muscles and triceps through a ballistic press pattern, making it a sport-specific power exercise for athletes requiring rapid upper body force generation in sports such as basketball and wrestling.

execution.starting_position: Stand facing a solid wall at an arm's length plus ball distance, or face a partner. Hold the medicine ball at chest height with both hands.
execution.setup_instructions: Use a solid, reinforced wall or trained partner. Stand 1–2 meters from the wall depending on rebound speed required.
steps: Step 1: Hold the medicine ball at chest height with both hands, elbows bent and pointing outward.
Step 2: Explosively extend the arms and push the ball into the wall or to a partner with maximum force.
Step 3: Catch the rebounding ball with both hands, absorbing slightly, then immediately load and re-throw.
Step 4: Maintain a stable stance throughout. Slight engagement of the legs and trunk on each throw.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale sharply on each throw. Inhale as you catch.
common_mistakes: Pausing between catch and throw — the stretch-shortening cycle requires a quick turnaround
Throwing with only the arms — a slight trunk and leg load increases power
Using too heavy a ball — reduces velocity and defeats the plyometric intent
safety_considerations: Use a medicine ball of appropriate weight — heavy enough for resistance, light enough for maximum velocity.
Ensure the wall can withstand repeated impacts.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full arm extension on throw. Catch with slightly bent elbows to absorb.
execution.tempo_recommendations: Rapid fire: 10–20 reps. Focus on minimizing time from catch to next throw.
coaching_cues: Throw hard — catch fast — throw again
Arm extension — not just a push
